speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Do Chinese people often visit science museums?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Yeah, I think a lot of Chinese people visit science museums. Because parents believe it helps children become smarter — you know, helps grow their IQ. And schools organize trips there too, for the same reason: people think visiting science museums makes you more logical and smarter. So they have this belief, and that's why they go often.
